name: Plate Single Leg Pinch Grip Deadlift
cardText:
Plate Single Leg Pinch Grip Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and facing forwards. Grip the sides of a weight plate with your palms facing down.
2
Balance on one foot, as you raise the weight keep your arms and back straight, while you bring your other foot back towards the ground
3
Keep four raised leg straight and in alignment with your back as you lower the plate back down to the starting position.

name: Plate Pinch Grip Side Bend
cardText:
Plate Pinch Grip Side Bend
Beginner
1
Stand straight with the plate held at your side
2
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
3
Return to the upright position.
4
Switch hands and repeat

name: Plate Pinch Grip Row
cardText:
Plate Pinch Grip Row
Intermediate
1
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.
2
Bend forward at your hips while maintaining a flat back.
3
Pull the plate toward your upper abdomen.
4
Lower the weight in a controlled manner and repeat.

name: Plate Pinch Grip Deadlift
cardText:
Plate Pinch Grip Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Stand facing the plate with your feet shoulder-width apart and the plate positioned between your feet.
2
Bend down and grasp the plate from the top edges with both hands, making sure your thumbs and fingers are evenly spaced.
3
Keep your back straight, chest up and core engaged, and stand up with the plate, keeping it close to your body.
4
Lower the plate back down to the ground, keeping control and maintaining good posture.

name: Plate Pinch Grip Farmer's Carry
cardText:
Plate Pinch Grip Farmer's Carry
Intermediate
1
Stand tall holding two plates in each hand with a pinch grip.
2
Walk for the desired distance or time.

name: Plate Staggered Pinch Grip Deadlift
cardText:
Plate Staggered Pinch Grip Deadlift
Advanced
1
Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding two plates with a pinch grip.
2
Place one foot slightly behind the other, with the heel of your back foot elevated.
3
From this starting position, bend at the hips and knees to lower the plates towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.

name: Plate Weighted Inverted Row
cardText:
Plate Weighted Inverted Row
Intermediate
1
Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip. Place a plate on your chest.
2
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
3
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

name: Weighted Chin Ups
cardText:
Weighted Chin Ups
Advanced
1
Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you). Use a dip belt and the let the weight hang between your legs.
2
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the bar.
3
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

name: Plate Weighted Dead Hang
cardText:
Plate Weighted Dead Hang
Intermediate
1
Attach weight to yourself using a dip belt. Grip a pull-up bar with palms facing forward.
2
Hang with arms fully extended.
3
Hold for recommended amount of time, keeping your core engaged.
